sentences.quote: CEO Michael Miebach, age 57, served as President and Chief Product Officer before taking over from Ajay Banga in 2021
sentences.text: Michael Miebach, 57, became chief executive of Mastercard in 2021, succeeding Ajay Banga after serving as the company's President and Chief Product Officer.
He brings a career of more than 25 years spanning payments, banking services and technology, including senior roles at Barclays and Citibank before joining Mastercard.
In his prior and current roles he played a key part in transforming the business from a consumer card issuer into a provider of varied multi-rail payment solutions.
He leads a "grow, diversify and build" strategy, working alongside CFO Sachin Mehra, 53, and a deep bench of senior talent.

Leadership updates effective August 3, 2026:
Ling Hai, President of Asia Pacific, Europe, Middle East and Africa, will become Chief Financial Officer, succeeding Sachin Mehra.
sentences.text: On June 2, 2026, Mastercard announced a broad reshuffle effective August 3: Ling Hai, President of Asia Pacific, Europe, Middle East and Africa, became Chief Financial Officer, succeeding Sachin Mehra, who moved to a new Chief Business Officer role covering global country operations; Linda Kirkpatrick became Chief Services Officer, succeeding Craig Vosburg; and Dimi Dosis became Chief Commercial Payments Officer, succeeding Raj Seshadri, with Vosburg named Vice Chair, Seshadri becoming senior strategic advisor to the CEO, and Vice Chair Tim Murphy retiring in October.

sentences.quote: Jorn Lambert, Chief Product Officer, will continue to lead Consumer Payments, bringing together the company's stablecoin, agentic and core payments.
